description:
[read-only] The TikTok pixels on the brand's selected TikTok ad account: numeric id (for campaign optimization), pixel code (siteTagId, for the site), status, last fired. Read-only. Needs the ads:manage scope.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/site-tags/tiktok/pixel.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

name: ads_tiktok_pixels_list
title: List the TikTok pixels
